<div class="sqs-html-content" data-sqsp-text-block-content>
  <h2 style="text-align:center;white-space:pre-wrap;"><strong>COTTAGE KING ENSUITE</strong></h2>
</div>
</div></div><div class="row sqs-row"><div class="col sqs-col-6 span-6"><div class="sqs-block html-block sqs-block-html" data-block-type="2" data-border-radii="&#123;&quot;topLeft&quot;:&#123;&quot;unit&quot;:&quot;px&quot;,&quot;value&quot;:0.0&#125;,&quot;topRight&quot;:&#123;&quot;unit&quot;:&quot;px&quot;,&quot;value&quot;:0.0&#125;,&quot;bottomLeft&quot;:&#123;&quot;unit&quot;:&quot;px&quot;,&quot;value&quot;:0.0&#125;,&quot;bottomRight&quot;:&#123;&quot;unit&quot;:&quot;px&quot;,&quot;value&quot;:0.0&#125;&#125;" data-sqsp-block="text" id="block-yui_3_17_2_1_1650284647010_88203"><div class="sqs-block-content">
<div class="sqs-html-content" data-sqsp-text-block-content>
  <p class="" style="white-space:pre-wrap;">A tranquil oasis, the Cottage King Ensuite boasts a luxurious king-size bed and a unique jungle-style outdoor ensuite bathroom. A quiet shared patio and a beautifully landscaped garden lounge provide additional spaces to relax. Whether you're looking to immerse yourself in nature or enjoy modern comforts, this room offers the best of both worlds.</p><p class="" style="white-space:pre-wrap;">From: Single 88 USD/night</p><p class="" style="white-space:pre-wrap;">&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;Double 116 USD/night</p>
</div>

Two rooms share a fully equipped bathroom with hot-water showers and essential amenities, making them perfect for guests seeking comfort in a shared setting.</p><p class="" style="white-space:pre-wrap;">From:  Single 53 USD/night</p><p class="" style="white-space:pre-wrap;">           Double 70 USD/night</p>

<div class="sqs-html-content" data-sqsp-text-block-content>
  <p class="" style="white-space:pre-wrap;">Designed for budget-conscious travelers, the <strong>Surfers Economy Rooms</strong> provide a laid-back and social atmosphere. These four rooms share a private courtyard and a cozy chill-out area, perfect for relaxing after a day in the water. Each room is fitted with a double bed and a cooling fan, while a shared ablution block with two showers and two toilets ensures convenience.</p><p class="" style="white-space:pre-wrap;">Price: Single 39 USD/night</p><p class="" style="white-space:pre-wrap;">           Double 50 USD/night</p>
